comment: Every Terraform root under stacks/ and how the nightly drift plan (.github/workflows/drift-plan.yml) and the PR plan/apply workflow (.github/workflows/terraform.yml) treat it. scripts/drift-stacks.py refuses a stacks/ directory that is not listed here. A standing entry tolerates ONE exact provider artifact and must link the issue that removes it.

aws-db-migration-runner.reason: Reviewed but never applied: no state object and no function exist. Applying it is governed by scripts/db-migration-runner-plan-apply.sh, not by the apply workflow.
